source_refs.note: Exercise 14.3, Question 13: moment about M(1, -3, 3) of the force AB, r = MA (book p.283). Answer key PDF 312: 48i - 4j + 30k.

blocks.prompt: 13. Find the moment about the point \(M(1, -3, 3)\) of the force represented by \(\underline{AB}\), where the coordinates of points \(A(4, 3, -1)\) and \(B(-1, 3, 7)\) are given.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh moment of force (force ka ghumane wala asar) ka sawal hai.
Humein \(M\) ke gird \(\underline{F}\) ka moment chahiye, jo ek vector hai.
Plan: pehle \(\underline{r} = \underline{MA}\), phir determinant se \(\underline{r} \times \underline{F}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: force \(\underline{F}\) jo point \(A(4, 3, -1)\) se guzarti hai; point \(M(1, -3, 3)\).
Humein find karna hai: \(M\) ke gird \(\underline{F}\) ka moment (ghumane wala asar).
Tareeqa: Moment \(= \underline{r} \times \underline{F}\) (14.3.7 (c)). Yahan \(\underline{r}\) us point \(M\) se, jis ke gird ghumana hai, force ki line wale point \(A\) tak ka vector hai. Misaal: darwaze ko qabze (hinge) ke gird ghumate hain; \(\underline{r}\) qabze se haath tak ka vector hai aur \(\underline{F}\) aap ka zor. Force \(\underline{AB}\) se represent ho rahi hai, yani \(\underline{F} = \underline{AB}\) = \(B\) ke coordinates minus \(A\) ke coordinates.

Force likhein
\[\underline{F} = \underline{AB} = (-1 - 4)\underline{i} + (3 - 3)\underline{j} + (7 - (-1))\underline{k}\]
\[= -5\underline{i} + 8\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(A\) se \(B\) tak ka vector = aakhri point minus shuru wala point. Yahi force ka rukh aur miqdaar hai.

\(\underline{r} = \underline{MA}\) nikalein
\[\underline{MA} = (4 - 1)\underline{i} + (3 - (-3))\underline{j} + (-1 - 3)\underline{k}\]
\[= 3\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} - 4\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{r}\) hamesha us point se shuru hota hai jis ke gird moment chahiye (\(M\)) aur force wale point (\(A\)) par khatam hota hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\underline{r}\) ulta le lein (\(A\) se \(M\)) to moment ka sign ulta aa jayega; yeh sab se aam ghalti hai.

Determinant likhein
\[\underline{r} \times \underline{F} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 3 & 6 & -4 \\ -5 & 0 & 8 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: Pehli row mein unit vectors \(\underline{i}, \underline{j}, \underline{k}\), doosri row mein pehle vector ke components \(\underline{r}\), teesri row mein doosre vector ke components \(\underline{F}\). Rows ki tarteeb wohi honi chahiye jo product ki tarteeb hai, warna jawab ka sign ulta ho jayega.

Teenon minors nikalein
\[\underline{i}\text{ minor} = (6)(8) - (-4)(0) = 48\]
\[\underline{j}\text{ minor} = (3)(8) - (-4)(-5) = 4\]
\[\underline{k}\text{ minor} = (3)(0) - (6)(-5) = 30\]
Kyun: Har unit vector ki row aur column ko dhak dein (cover kar dein); jo 2 by 2 bachta hai us ka (upar baayan)(neeche daayan) minus (upar daayan)(neeche baayan) minor hai. Har product ko bracket mein likhne se negative signs ki ghalti nahi hoti.

Signs \(+, -, +\) lagayein
\[\underline{r} \times \underline{F} = \underline{i}(48) - \underline{j}(4) + \underline{k}(30)\]
\[= 48\underline{i} - 4\underline{j} + 30\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Determinant ko pehli row ke saath kholte waqt signs ka pattern \(+, -, +\) hota hai, yani beech wala \(\underline{j}\) ka term minus ho kar aata hai.
Dhyan dein: Sab se zyada ghalti isi beech wale minus mein hoti hai; \(-\underline{j}(\text{minor})\) mein minor khud negative ho to jawab plus ban jata hai.

Moment ki miqdaar (magnitude)
\[|\underline{r} \times \underline{F}| = \sqrt{(48)^2 + (-4)^2 + (30)^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{3220} = 2 \sqrt{805}\]
Kyun: Lambai batati hai ke ghumane ka asar kitna taqatwar hai; sawal ne sirf moment maanga hai, magnitude izafi maloomat hai.

Tasdeeq
\[(\underline{r} \times \underline{F}) \cdot \underline{F} = (48)(-5) + (-4)(0) + (30)(8)\]
\[= -240 + 0 + 240 = 0\]
Kyun: Moment \(\underline{r} \times \underline{F}\) cross product hai, is liye \(\underline{F}\) (aur \(\underline{r}\)) dono par perpendicular hona chahiye. Dot product zero aaya, to hisaab sahi hai.
